name: Celestial armor
description: celestial armor of polished black silver: two small ornate filigree plates, each in the form of a thick crescent moon curving inward and tapering to fine points, covering the centre of each breast in the area of a small bikini cup, and one matching small ornate plate in the form of a small moth-wing shape pointing down covering the front of the hips; every plate is engraved with pale moonstone inlay and a tracery of moth-wing veins and set with a pale moonstone; each plate hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and unconnected to any other; the rest of the torso, the sides of the hips, the back, shoulders and arms are bare skin
notes: Necromancer / Darkness. Signature earned armor: small filigree plates at bikini-cup coverage, a different shape per sister, held by magic.
